sources.title: GitHub - karti-b/ETF-trading: Creating an ETF portfolio and following ...
sources.snippet: Here we'll try to implement one of many very popular hedge fund strategies by creating a portfolio of an ETF and it's underlying stocks. I am going to create an algorithm that tracks every single stock from the ETF and manages portfolio by moving capital between ETF itself and underlying stocks. The main trigger of buying/selling stocks is based on Relative Strength Index (RSI) indicator.
